resources.string: A second look at every new SMS.
Spot suspicious requests and trace the evidence, entirely on your phone.

• No internet permission or cloud analysis.
• Only new SMS; no inbox history.
• Never blocks, deletes, or replies to carrier SMS.
• OTPs, passwords, card numbers, and account suffixes are masked before saving.
• Turn monitoring off or delete records anytime.

Sender, received time, masked message, rule matches, verified AI quotes, explanation, verdict, model name, and measured timing. Stored in this app’s private database. It is not encrypted; device security protects access. Android backup and transfer are disabled. Raw unmasked SMS and raw AI responses are never saved.

Rules screen each new SMS first. A small offline model analyzes flagged messages, then every quoted span is checked against the saved masked text. A matching quote does not prove that the AI’s reasoning is right.

SMS only: no RCS, Messenger, Viber, or WhatsApp. SMS permission is needed; this app is not the default SMS handler. It never blocks, replies to, or deletes carrier SMS. Force-stop prevents receipt until you open the app again. Some phones restrict background apps; review the phone’s battery settings if alerts stop. Notifications can be disabled without stopping analysis.

AI can miss scams or flag legitimate messages. It can be slow, use substantial RAM and battery, and produce incorrect Filipino explanations. AI requires arm64 FP16/dot-product CPU support and at least 6 GB RAM; physical-device reliability has not yet been verified. Google Play restricts SMS permissions; this build is for sideloading.

SALAG TRACE 1.0.0
Built with OpenAI Codex assistance from the supplied implementation plan. Runtime AI: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct, running locally through llama.cpp. No cloud AI or analytics.

App and llama.cpp: MIT. Qwen2.5: Apache 2.0. AndroidX and Kotlin: Apache 2.0. IBM Plex fonts: SIL Open Font License. Full notices and development disclosure are in the repository.
